rows.section: Multipliers 2026: canton, cantonal capital (Frauenfeld; other communes differ) and church tax
rows.label: Cantonal multiplier (multiple of the simple tax)
rows.note: Total income tax = simple tax × (cantonal + communal + church multiplier); church tax only for members. The communal and church figures are those of the cantonal capital, Frauenfeld; other communes in Thurgau set their own multipliers. Multiples as listed by the ESTV (1.19 = 119%).
rows.source_title: ESTV: Steuerfüsse der Kantonshauptorte 1995 - 2026 der natürlichen Personen (XLSX, sheet NP 2026; updated 14 September 2026)

rows.section: Corporate profit tax 2026 (Thurgau)
rows.label: Profit tax rate, companies and cooperatives
rows.note: The federal profit tax of 8.5% comes on top (national page). Simple rates are multiplied by the cantonal and communal multipliers where a canton uses them; each canton may raise the rate for companies in international groups where a foreign state requires a minimum tax.
rows.source_title: ESTV Kantonsblatt Thurgau (Stand Februar 2026), Juristische Personen: Steuerberechnung, § 85 StG

rows.section: Property tax: Liegenschaftssteuer (Thurgau)
rows.label: Who levies it
rows.value: The canton (57% of the yield goes to the political municipality)
rows.note: An annual tax on the gross value of real estate (no debt deduction), separate from the wealth tax. Rates in per mille are shown as percentages (1.5 per mille = 0.15%).
rows.source_title: Thurgau Steuergesetz (StG, RB 640.1), Stand 1. Januar 2025 (version in force until 31 December 2026), Liegenschaftensteuer

rows.section: Property tax: Liegenschaftssteuer (Thurgau)
rows.label: Rate (share of the tax value, no debt deduction)
rows.note: An annual tax on the gross value of real estate (no debt deduction), separate from the wealth tax. Rates in per mille are shown as percentages (1.5 per mille = 0.15%).
rows.source_title: Thurgau Steuergesetz (StG, RB 640.1), Stand 1. Januar 2025 (version in force until 31 December 2026), Liegenschaftensteuer

rows.section: Property transfer tax: Handänderungssteuer (Thurgau)
rows.label: Transfer tax rate
rows.note: A tax on the transfer of ownership of real estate, separate from the property gains tax (Grundstückgewinnsteuer) on the seller's gain.
rows.source_title: Thurgau Steuergesetz (StG, RB 640.1), Stand 1. Januar 2025 (version in force until 31 December 2026), §§ 140 and 141

rows.section: Property transfer tax: Handänderungssteuer (Thurgau)
rows.label: Who pays
rows.value: The acquirer (the seller is jointly liable)
rows.note: A tax on the transfer of ownership of real estate, separate from the property gains tax (Grundstückgewinnsteuer) on the seller's gain.
rows.source_title: Thurgau Steuergesetz (StG, RB 640.1), Stand 1. Januar 2025 (version in force until 31 December 2026), §§ 140 and 141
